name: Facet
description:
Facet is a self-hosted personal profile platform that lets you create multiple views of your professional profile for different audiences (recruiters, conferences, clients). 
        
        You own your data and control what each audience sees. 
        
        Default password: changeme123 ((you will be prompted to change it on first login)

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Public URL for Facet (e.g. http://IP_ADDRESS:8080). Used for OAuth callbacks and share links.

variables.name: Admin Emails
variables.description: Comma-separated email allowlist for OAuth login

variables.name: Behind Proxy
variables.description: Set to true if running behind a reverse proxy

variables.name: OAuth - Google - Client ID
variables.description: Client ID for 'Sign in with Google'. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

variables.name: OAuth - Google - Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret from Google Cloud Console.

variables.name: OAuth - GitHub - Client ID
variables.description: Client ID for 'Sign in with GitHub'. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

variables.name: OAuth - GitHub - Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret from GitHub OAuth Apps.

variables.name: AI - OpenAI - API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenAI services. Required for AI features powered by OpenAI.

variables.name: AI - Anthropic - API Key
variables.description: API key for Anthropic services. Required for AI features powered by Anthropic.

variables.name: AI - Ollama - URL
variables.description: URL for Ollama API. Required for AI features powered by Ollama.

variables.name: AI - Ollama - Model
variables.description: Model name for Ollama API. Required for AI features powered by Ollama.

author: nwithan8
